prediction: Before new edits, freeze source/derived answer-contrast Jacobians, source-only isolated controls, and first Adam-step D predictions for all four cells. Only ba/bb are prospective outcomes.
controls: Two source facts, each with a-c and b-c contrasts; minimum Euclidean norm, relative eigenvalue cutoff 1e-10. D is not used to construct controls. These preserve two contrasts of the other source to first order, not all logits or R.
primary: 1024-step four-cell D answer pattern and row/column effects, paired within the same person. E, local retention, broad U, full held-out D and autonomous two-step are co-reported.
secondary: Pre-edit isolated root/personal response; small-step calibration; frozen first-step prediction; response drift and interval linearization along all saved checkpoints. Initial derivatives are not asserted to predict the nonlinear endpoint.
interpretation: Two existing development worlds. Seeds, cases, cells and probes are nested, not independent worlds. No new significance claims, no hyperparameter selection on D/U, no layer or editor sweep.
conditional_intervention: Source-isolated perturbations are the first causal response experiment. A repair of an internal component is a separate follow-up only if the response test identifies a useful target; do not manufacture a repair by training new D labels.
